name: 48081 · St Clr Shores, MI
findings: ZIP 48081 (St Clr Shores) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48081 (St Clr Shores) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
